comment: Variants for .github/workflows/guest-cpu.yml (tests/guest-cpu-native.py). query: page parameters added to the base; setup: shell commands typed into the guest right after sys.boot_completed=1 (experiments only); timescale: the page's time dilation for this variant (default 8); browser_like: after settling, QEMU is slowed (cgroup cpu.max) until the guest runs the browser probe's calibration loop in this many guest seconds, as the page's guest does (about 2 at timescale 8), so that Android's timeouts fire as in the browser; launch_timeout: seconds per start. apps: what is started after the guest settled, each a cold start; how=tap is a finger tap at x,y (fractions of the screen) as the page sends it, how=start is am start. ui: the UI check after the starts. Round 8: "not responding" reports at browser speed (slow*), what keeps the guest busy after Android drew Gallery, and SwiftShader's settings (ss*, /SwiftShader.ini, which every process that draws reads from its working directory /). Round 9: a profile of a Gallery start (base, simpleperf by thread and symbol), and whether SwiftShader reads /SwiftShader.ini at all (ThreadCount=4 gives surfaceflinger more threads). anr-stop*: SystemUI is stopped (SIGSTOP) for 75 guest seconds right after the boot, so that the next TIME_TICK broadcast times out for it, as during a slow launch; the setup prints the new am_anr entries, the trace files, the ticks of all Signal Catcher threads and the guest's /proc/stat around it: as is, with no trace path, and with SystemUI as ActivityManager's debug app (set, then the framework restarted). after_settle: shell commands typed once the guest has settled. Round 10: all of SwiftShader's IR optimization passes off, ThreadCount=4 with a surfaceflinger thread count, HWUI's OpenGL pipeline against Skia's (debug.hwui.renderer), with QEMU's code-buffer flushes per start; and the cost of one ANR on a settled guest, with traces and with an ANR trace directory nothing can be created in.

' > /SwiftShader.ini; mount -o remount,ro /; cat /SwiftShader.ini; setprop ctl.restart surfaceflinger; sleep 5; echo restarted

mount -o remount,rw / && printf '[Processor]\nThreadCount=4\n' > /SwiftShader.ini; mount -o remount,ro /; cat /SwiftShader.ini; ls -l /SwiftShader.ini; setprop ctl.restart surfaceflinger; sleep 5; echo restarted
sleep 8; echo SFTASKS:$(ls /proc/$(pidof surfaceflinger)/task | wc -l); cat /proc/$(pidof surfaceflinger)/task/*/comm | sort | uniq -c | tr '\n' ' '

SC() { t=0; for f in /proc/[0-9]*/task/[0-9]*/stat; do read -r l < $f || continue; case $l in *'(Signal Catcher)'*) set -- ${l##*) }; t=$((t+${12}+${13}));; esac; done 2>/dev/null; echo $t; }; p=$(pidof com.android.systemui); c0=$(SC); a0=$(logcat -b events -d | grep -c am_anr); f0=$(ls /data/anr | wc -l); s0=$(head -1 /proc/stat); kill -STOP $p; sleep 75; kill -CONT $p; sleep 60; s1=$(head -1 /proc/stat); c1=$(SC); echo ANRTEST: anr $(( $(logcat -b events -d | grep -c am_anr) - a0 )) files $(( $(ls /data/anr | wc -l) - f0 )) signal_catcher_ticks $((c1 - c0)); echo STAT0 $s0; echo STAT1 $s1; logcat -b events -d | grep am_anr | tail -2 | cut -c1-170; logcat -d -b system | grep -e dumpStackTraces -e 'ANR traces' -e 'trace path' -e 'ANR in' | tail -5 | cut -c1-170; ls -l /data/anr | tail -3; dumpsys window | grep -o 'Application Not Responding: [a-z.]*' | sort -u
setprop dalvik.vm.stack-trace-dir ''; setprop dalvik.vm.stack-trace-file /proc/porty-no-traces; getprop dalvik.vm.stack-trace-dir; getprop dalvik.vm.stack-trace-file

grep ' /data ' /proc/mounts | cut -d' ' -f1-3; sync; echo 3 > /proc/sys/vm/drop_caches; f=$(awk '/MemFree/{print int($2/1024)}' /proc/meminfo); n=$((f-96)); echo free $f MiB, filling $n; [ $n -ge 16 ] && dd if=/dev/zero of=/data/local/tmp/.porty-zero bs=1048576 count=$n 2>&1 | tail -1; rm -f /data/local/tmp/.porty-zero; sync; grep -e MemFree -e '^Cached' /proc/meminfo; echo gallery $(pidof com.android.gallery3d) settings $(pidof com.android.settings)
